get_global_actionengine_client: get the global singleton instance of ActionEngineClient with a WebRTC stream and NodeMap
create_action_with_client: create an action by name using the ActionEngineClient make_action method with an optional action ID
create_final_node_fragment: create a final NodeFragment with empty data and octet-stream mimetype for a given node ID and sequence
convert_fragment_to_json: convert a NodeFragment to a JSON-serializable dictionary with optional base64 encoding and metadata inclusion
set_action_registry_on_client: set the ActionRegistry on an ActionEngineClient instance to enable action creation
